name: sCrow
description: High-fidelity minimalist Solana escrow dApp with a zero-scroll 4-card playing deck UI, deterministic 3-strike revision controls enforced on-chain, and 100% PDA rent reclamation.

tools.name: scrow_create_deck
tools.description: Instantiates and funds an ephemeral sCrow Anchor PDA via the user's PayBox vault (`initialize_escrow`).

creator.description: Creator Solana wallet address from PayBox vault.

recipient.description: Recipient Solana wallet address delivering the work.

amountSol.description: Amount of SOL to lock in the ephemeral Escrow PDA.

terms.description: Plaintext deliverable milestones hashed into the 32-byte on-chain `terms_hash`.

isTimed.description: Whether this escrow enforces a delivery deadline timer.

duration.description: Deadline duration string when `isTimed` is true (e.g. '24h', '7 days').

tools.name: scrow_submit_work
tools.description: Submits PR or deliverable proof metadata URL to transition the sCrow PDA from `Pending` to `InReview` (`submit_work`).

recipient.description: Recipient wallet signing the work submission.

submissionUrl.description: GitHub PR URL, IPFS URI, or deployment proof link (max 256 chars).

tools.name: scrow_review_work
tools.description: Executes creator approval or increments the deterministic revision strike counter (Strike 1-3). If `attempts_used == 3`, automatically transitions PDA state to `Refunded` and returns full principal to creator (`review_work`).

creator.description: Creator wallet address with review authority.

approved.description: True to approve work and release payout; False to request revision and increment strike counter.

feedback.description: Optional review notes or revision requirements.

tools.name: scrow_release_payout
tools.description: Settles the sCrow escrow by deducting a 0.75% protocol fee to the sCrow Protocol Treasury, sending 99.25% to the recipient, and executing `close_account` to reclaim 100% of PDA SOL rent back to the creator (`release_payout`).

creator.description: Creator wallet address reclaiming 100% of the closed PDA rent.
